Exported Types

group Pb_Adv_Exported_Types

Types associated with the advertisement provisioning states and operations.

Typedefs

typedef uint8_t pb_adv_link_close_reason_t

Type alias matching _pb_adv_link_close_reason_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Enums

enum pb_adv_link_state_t

Enumeration for the states of the advertisement link during provisioning.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_STATE_CLOSED

Link is closed; no active provisioning.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_STATE_OPENING

Link is in the process of opening to establish provisioning.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_STATE_OPENED

Link is opened successfully and ready for provisioning; default operational state.

enum pb_adv_rx_state_t

Enumeration representing the receiving states in advertisement provisioning.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_RX_STATE_IDLE

Receiver is idle, not processing packets; default idle state.

enumerator PB_ADV_RX_STATE_START

Receiver is processing start packets to initialize provisioning.

enumerator PB_ADV_RX_STATE_CONTINUE

Receiver is processing continue packets; ensures data flow during provisioning.

enum pb_adv_tx_state_t

Enumeration of transmitting states used in advertisement provisioning.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_TX_STATE_IDLE

Transmitter is idle; not sending any packets.

enumerator PB_ADV_TX_STATE_SENDING

Transmitter is sending and possibly waiting for acknowledgment.

enum pb_adv_role_t

Enumeration for roles in advertisement provisioning.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_ROLE_PROVISIONER

Provisioner role initiating the provisioning process.

enumerator PB_ADV_ROLE_DEVICE

Device role being provisioned during the advertisement process.

enum pb_adv_cb_type_t

Enumeration for callback types in advertisement provisioning.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_CB_TYPE_LINK_OPEN

Callback for link open event; signals successful link establishment.

enumerator PB_ADV_CB_TYPE_LINK_CLOSED

Callback for link closed event; indicates termination of link.

enumerator PB_ADV_CB_TYPE_TX_COMPLETE

Callback when transmission is complete; confirms data has been sent.

enumerator PB_ADV_CB_TYPE_RX_COMPLETE

Callback when reception is complete; confirms data has been received.

enum pb_adv_opcode_t

Enumeration for opcodes used in advertisement provisioning link control.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_OPEN

Opcode for opening a link; initiates a provisioning session.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_ACK

Opcode for acknowledging a link operation; ensures communication continuity.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_CLOSE

Opcode for closing a link; terminates the provisioning session.

enum _pb_adv_link_close_reason_t

Enumeration for reasons a link might be closed. Use pb_adv_link_close_reason_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_CLOSE_SUCCESS

Link closed successfully with no active transactions; default idle closure.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_CLOSE_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT

Link closed due to transaction timeout; indicates failure in communication.

enumerator PB_ADV_LINK_CLOSE_PROVISIONING_FAIL

Link closed due to provisioning failure; error in provisioning process.
